name: Discover it Secured Cash Back
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee; refundable deposit of $49, $99 or $200 unlocks a larger credit line
balance_transfer_fee: 5% on transfers posted at a promotional APR, none at the standard Transfer APR
late_payment_fee: None the first time you pay late, up to $41 after that

welcome_bonus.bonus: Cashback Match, which doubles every dollar of cash back you earn in your first year
welcome_bonus.requirement: automatic on all cash back earned from account approval through your first 365 days, with no minimum spend and no cap, paid within two billing periods

verdict.text: Opens at a $49 deposit and still pays the full 5%, rare for secured

earn_rates.category: Rotating quarterly categories, up to the quarterly maximum, once you activate

earn_note: Unusually for a secured card the rewards are real: the same 5% rotating categories and 1% base as the flagship, doubled in year one. The 5% still needs activating, and Discover's category calendar has been offline since August 2026. The point here is payment history, not rewards.

redemption_options.method: Partner gift cards, which carry at least 5% added value
Statement credit or deposit to a bank account

points.note: Same redemption menu as the rest of the Discover lineup. Cash back is a flat 1 cent as a statement credit or bank deposit, with no minimum and no expiry while the account is open, and partner gift cards carry a guaranteed 5% minimum added value, so $47.50 of rewards buys a $50 card. The gift card minimum rose from $5 to $25 with the move to Capital One, which bites harder here than elsewhere, since a credit-building card with a small limit generates rewards slowly.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners. Cashback Bonus is cash, not a transferable currency.

protection_note: Nothing here, which is consistent across every Discover card since the February 2018 cuts and the removal of price protection that October. The current cardmember agreement carries no benefit terms at all. For a credit-building card this matters less than it would elsewhere, since the job is establishing a payment history rather than insuring purchases, but it is worth knowing that graduating to the unsecured version does not unlock protections either. There are none to unlock.
rental_note: No rental car coverage, primary or secondary. Renting a car on this card means relying on your own auto policy or buying the counter's collision waiver.

services.name: Refundable security deposit, tiered rather than flat
services.detail: A $49, $99 or $200 minimum deposit, tiered by your creditworthiness at approval, opens an account with a credit line of at least $200. Worth noting that the deposit does not simply become your credit line the way it does on most secured cards, so $49 down can still open a $200 line. You can deposit more to start higher, and you have 35 days after approval to fund it, before activating the card. The maximum limit runs $1,000 to $3,000 depending on creditworthiness.

services.name: No interest paid on the deposit
services.detail: The money sits in a Security Deposit Account that is FDIC insured and stays in your name, but it earns nothing while it is held, and you cannot withdraw from it while the account is open. That is a real if small cost of the card, since the same cash in a savings account would earn.

services.name: Path to an unsecured card
services.detail: Used responsibly, the account can be unsecured, at which point the deposit comes back as a statement credit and the account becomes the standard Discover it Cash Back, with all other terms unchanged. Otherwise the deposit is refunded when you close the account and pay the balance in full. Discover no longer publishes a review timetable, so the widely repeated "automatic reviews from month 7" figure describes the older version of this card and should not be relied on.

services.name: $0 fraud liability
services.detail: You are never held responsible for unauthorized purchases. No enrollment needed.

services.name: Free FICO score
services.detail: Your FICO score from TransUnion on your statement and in the app, with the factors moving it. Genuinely useful on a credit-building card, since it lets you watch the thing you are trying to move.

services.name: Social Security number alerts
services.detail: Daily dark web scans for your SSN plus new-account alerts on your credit report. Requires enrollment, and only the primary cardmember can sign up.

services.name: Freeze It
services.detail: Freeze the account from the app or website to block new purchases and cash advances if you misplace the card.

services.name: 24/7 US-based customer service
services.detail: Live agents at any hour, without a menu tree to fight through first.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Their spending earns cash back into your account
Shares your credit line, which starts small on a secured card
Any purchase protection or travel coverage

additional_cards.note: Free to add, though a secured card's opening limit is low enough that sharing it usually creates more friction than it is worth.

timeline.text: The card returns, rebuilt on Capital One's secured platform with materially better terms than the version that was pulled. The deposit is now tiered at $49, $99 or $200 based on creditworthiness rather than a flat $200 minimum, and the rewards move from 2% on gas and restaurants to the same 5% rotating categories the flagship card earns.

Discover stops accepting new applications for its secured card on June 2, saying the pause is temporary and the product will relaunch later in the year. Existing cardholders were not told of changes at the time.
Capital One completes its acquisition of Discover Financial Services. Discover Bank later merges into Capital One, N.A., though the cards keep Discover branding and terms.

Discover drops purchase protection, extended warranty, return guarantee, auto rental collision coverage and travel accident insurance across its consumer cards. This is why the protections section below is empty.
